method.method_draft: Build the total by adding only new plants region by region. From the image, start with all of A, then observe that B contributes some plants already counted in A, and C also contributes some plants already counted in A; B and C do not overlap each other. From the text, A contributes 500 plants. Of B's 450 plants, 50 are already in A, so B adds 450−50=400 new plants. Of C's 350 plants, 100 are already in A, so C adds 350−100=250 new plants. Add disjoint contributions: 500+400+250=1150.
